title: 2. Porque elas não olham para você

queries.text: "fêmeas fatais" → "fatal females", keeping the approved "female" (fêmea) and the author’s play on "femme fatale". Alternative: "femmes fatales".
"as gostosonas" (slang augmentative: sexy, curvy women) → "the hotties". Alternative: "the sexiest babes".
The original says "as 24% restantes" after 74% (the remainder would be 26%). Kept "24%" as in the original; possibly a slip of the author.
"phalus erectus" is already Latin in the original and kept as written (the usual spelling would be "phallus"). "quatro metros" kept in meters (about 13 feet).
